questions.note: The + operator: on duplicate string keys the left array wins.
Sorts are stable since 8.0: x and z keep their order on a tie.
String keys of a spread array become named arguments.
First-class callable syntax binds $this at creation time.
Late static binding: static::class is the receiver's class.
Inside the set hook, $this->x writes the backing store (no recursion): 5*2.
insteadof picks the implementation; as keeps the other under an alias.
A trait's static property is copied into each consuming class.
A return in finally overrides the return from try.
An exception from finally replaces the in-flight one — the last thrown is caught.
The use alias applies to unqualified names; a leading \ escapes to the global scope.
Dynamic names are not resolved against the namespace — 'Foo' is the global class.
After a by-ref foreach, $v remains a reference to the last element.
A method's static variable belongs to the parent's method — subclasses share it.
send() resumes the generator: $x = 10, return 10+1.
yield from yields the delegated generator's return value last.
